What You’ll Learn In Each Module
The masterclass is structured around four key areas where AI can deliver immediate value for finance teams. Here’s what you can expect:
Module 1: AI and the Future of Financial Intelligence
AI is redefining how finance teams operate. You will explore:
Why manual work is still dominant and risky
How AI helps identify hidden inefficiencies
The difference between automation, AI agents, and agentic AI
How to start mapping where AI fits into your close and consolidation processes
By the end, you will understand why forward-thinking teams are moving beyond spreadsheets and batch processes to systems that support real-time analysis and decision-making.
Module 2: Building Smart Workflows with Trigger Agents
Get introduced to Trigger Agents: AI-powered bots that monitor your general ledger and take action in real time based on natural language logic. You will learn:
How to write clear, finance-aware prompts
How to translate business rules into agent logic
Where to start automating journal entries, eliminations, and reconciliations
How Nominal’s agent infrastructure integrates seamlessly with your ERP
This is where theory becomes practice, showing exactly how your team can reduce bottlenecks and improve accuracy.
Module 3: AI for Your Role – CFOs, Controllers, Accountants
Each finance role has different needs and opportunities for AI. Learn how intelligent workflows can support:
CFOs: From dashboards to dynamic scenario planning and real-time forecasting
Controllers: From checklist reviews to continuous oversight and anomaly detection
Accountants: From manual reconciliations to contextual insights and guidance
You will also see how Nominal connects these workflows across your entire finance organization, creating a unified, intelligent finance operation.
The final module consolidates everything you have learned and prepares you for next steps:
A role-based action plan to help you apply what you’ve learned
A short quiz that, once completed, awards your Nominal AI Mastery Badge
